title: I can’t stop smiling. I love when survivor is great!!!! #survivor50 #...
transcript: Just finished episode 2 of survivor 50 in the hands of the fans. If you haven't watched episode 2 yet, swipe away. I really like this episode. I'm so happy with how survivor 50 is going. We're really getting a lot of all the things I was hoping for the most. I love that we got to see Ozzy and coach sniping at each other. Camilla's face. That would have been me the entire time. I'm also glad they did give us a lot of like, reaction to Kyle leaving because I knew it would hit a lot of people really hard. And getting to see like, Camilla's full reaction was like, so sad and so beautiful. I loved how like, Jen was so devastated. Like, I just. I love Kyle. The Reward challenge was so much fun to watch. I like that it had a bunch of different elements then the tribe dynamics have been really interesting. I'm a huge Aubrey fan, I always have been, and I don't love that she feels like she's kind of on the bottom. I still feel like she's connected with anybody on her tribe. I wish her and Jen could figure it out cause I think they'd be a really cool duo. I love the edit of him going through her bag and then she still got the boomerang. I don't hope she's to her advantage. I love that Rizzo's like, I'm not here to play camp, I'm here to like, backstab Like, yeah, Rizzo, you do you, even though your whole tribe is gonna hate you. It just really shows how every season of survivor so different, like, how the dynamics play out. His season, you know, two weeks ago, clearly, which is just, like, not a thing. This tribe dynamic is really strange. I wish we got to see them go to tribal, cause I'd be very curious how it would all fall out. It feels like Christie's probably at the bottom, but there's just, like, a lot of play here, and I'm like, very curious. And then, of course, this tribe, which I'm sad. I don't like that we lost twice now, but I love how much we're getting from this tribe cause this is my favorite. I'm so obsessed, so, so deeply obsessed still with Christian Devins and Emily Flippin. A gift to me personally, and honestly, this has brought me endless amounts of joy. First off, Ozzy just recognizing Siri for the brilliant, genius mind she is. The game is different now, but Siri can always adapt, and Ozzy's like, oh, I need that. Gotta recognize our girl. Take it back a little bit. I always really like the snake challenge. I thought this was a really interesting one, having all teams of two do it first. really question their choice of sending Rizzo and Jen first. Then it paid off, because even though they were, like, behind, they were able to catch up and I am deeply, deeply obsessed with the fight between Devons and Joe because I famously hate the honor and integrity code of survivor. Give me bloody backstabbing every day. And this tribe said, yeah, what are we doing? Did a good job in the edit of making me think that Joe was going home. Never really thought Ozzy was going home. But alas, our poor Savannah. Here's the thing. I am not sad to see her go because I just saw a whole season of Savannah, but I did feel bad because that's got to be really hard just in terms of, like, she was a completely unknown entity. They had never seen her season. All they know is that she won, and she never really found her, like, footing. She said in tribal that she felt like she'd kind of been closed off. But I mostly just think that no one really wanted to work with her because no one knew who she was. I don't think she ever really made a big mistake other than their I've lost and she ended up at the bottom. But it's got to be hard going from winning survivor two weeks ago to getting eliminated second. And I have to imagine the last few weeks were hard knowing that this was coming. I'm very excited and a little bit nervous for Tribe Swap next week. And I hope everyone remembers the cardinal rule. Never target Siri.
